_comment: Tier-2: non-homogeneous Dirichlet needs AssignScalarVariableProcess with constrained=True; constrained=False applies the value but leaves the DOF free, so the solver overwrites it. Pitfall (kratos.heat #1). Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). Measured through the core process module KratosMultiphysics.assign_scalar_variable_process: with constrained=false, Node.IsFixed(TEMPERATURE) is False while the value IS set to 50.0; with constrained=true IsFixed is True and the value is likewise 50.0. Both halves matter — the value being applied in both cases is exactly why the omission is silent. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass.
